ADDED i2: Two sibling divs, each containing two paragraphs, so the document tree has enough depth and breadth to exercise a full document-order traversal.
ADDED i3: Calling hasNext() many times before any next() must not consume the first node.
ADDED i4: The very first next() still returns the root, proving the prior hasNext() calls did not advance the iterator. The full walk visits every node in document order.
ADDED i5: After the traversal is exhausted, hasNext() must report false.
ADDED i6: Drains the iterator and asserts that the visited nodes, rendered as a semicolon-separated summary, match {@code expected} exactly.
